title: APEX utilitys
description: an utility/qol for casual players and pvp masters
body:
![apex](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5bd3d42bdcbc295404292265c742bd7f850f7825.png)
## APEX is an mod that is here to fuse it all!
this mod as the features that **you  will need** to make your experience **_better_**!
**Dynamic Armor HUD**: View your equipped gear and exact durability numbers on your screen. No more guessing when your chestplate is about to break.

**Intuitive Edit Mode (F6)**: Don’t like where the HUD is? Press F6 to free your mouse and drag the armor display anywhere on your screen. Press again to lock and save.

**Precision Potion Timers**: Replaces the vague vanilla icons with an accurate MM:SS countdown, allowing you to time your aggressive plays perfectly.

**Low Health Pulse**: A non-intrusive red vignette pulses when you drop below 4 hearts, giving you a biological cue to heal without distracting you from the fight.

**Performance First**: Optimized with custom Mixins to ensure the mod only runs logic when necessary. It’s lightweight, fast, and compatible with other performance mods like Sodium.

and much more!
